notes.title: Roadmap for Part 2 Story
notes.content:
Hello! This is Captain Bae, who is working hard to create a new game!

It's already been 3 months since Fantasia was released.

The second half of the story will soon be completed, and we want to complete Fantasia.

1. New stages, monsters and bosses

2. Boss patterning

3. Add new characters

4. New Content Gemstone.

(The items and images currently entered are under development and may differ slightly from the image contents after the update.)



[u][b]1. New stage, monster, boss[/b][/u]

-> A total of 5 stages from stage 7 to stage 12 will be added, and the full-fledged Planet Eater will begin to move.
From stage 7, all monsters become stronger, and gimmick-type monsters directly influenced by Planet Eater will appear and harass players, so please be careful!

[u][b]2. Boss patterning[/b][/u]

->New boss monsters that appear from stage 7 will have a pattern for each physical strength, unlike the bosses in the early stages, and will put more pressure on the players.


[u][b]3. New characters added.[/b][/u]

-> As the activities of Planet Eater become active and powerful bosses and monsters appear, Captain Bae decides to dispatch two outstanding agents to the scene.

The names of the agents are YeonAh and Marso, and we hope you clear the stage with ease using your own characteristics!

[url=https://i.ibb.co/sH8C85t/image.png][img]https://i.ibb.co/sH8C85t/image.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://i.ibb.co/zGtDs3Q/image.png][img]https://i.ibb.co/zGtDs3Q/image.png[/img][/url]

[u][b]4. New content gemstone.[/b][/u]

->With all of Pandora's powers unlocked, Captain Bae supplies the agents with gemstones that can further amplify Pandora's powers.

Defeat Planet Eater and his minions more easily by strengthening the gemstone, which amplifies Pandora's power and greatly increases the agent's stats.

The second half of the story update is likely to be done in mid-June, and we will also show the play directly through Steam streaming or Twitch broadcasting.

Due to bugs and balance patch work that occurred during testing, there was a problem with the progress of the work. We are very sorry for the slight delay in the update schedule.

If the schedule is made a little faster, we will notify you in advance, so please give us a lot of interest!

notes.title: 2023-03-27 Update
notes.content:
Hello! This is Captain Bae, the developer.

Today is the last update of Part 1! As mentioned before, we would like to inform you of the development status by revealing a brief roadmap for the 2nd part 7-12 region update currently under development in April.


  After clearing the 1st round, the account is initialized and every time the 2nd round starts, the skippable part of the story has been changed so that it can be skipped from the 1st round.

-> There are many people who want to quickly skip through the story and play the game, so it has been modified so that skipping is possible from the first playthrough.


We will continue to fix and upload additional bugs that are found later!
Part 2 also adds various monsters, special gimmicks, and final boss raids, so please look forward to it!

notes.title: 2023-03-06 Update
notes.content:
Hello! This is Captain Bae of Endev. We always appreciate the players who enjoy our game, and we will post updates this week.

There are some minor changes from the existing tutorial.

It often happens that notifications about gathering all the three pieces by stage, unit management, and notifications by each area are skipped before they are even shown due to the mouse flick.

Therefore, since the tutorial was modified based on the 1-4 stage and 2-1 stage tutorials, it has now been changed so that you can check all the tutorial contents once and pass them when you want.


Currently, we are concentrating on developing stages 7-12 in the second half. After March 30th, the second half road map will be released and will be officially released when all stages are completed.
Players' comments and interest are a great help to the developers! We look forward to your love.

notes.title: 2023-02-27 Update
notes.content:
Hello! This is the update that goes into effect today!

1. Hard 3 ghost respawn 0.2 seconds -> changed to 0.5 seconds.
-> It was summoned separately from the monster summoned by the giant bomb boss, so it did not cause much difficulty for the players, so the summoning cycle was delayed a bit.

2. Hard 1 hell stage boss active cooldown has been lowered from 5 to 6 seconds.
-> Hellchang Boss's active attack was applied too quickly and it was difficult to properly attack, so I lowered it by 1 second, lowering the time players can attack by 1 second.

3. Bzart flat hit sound has been added.

4. Sylvia's melee normal hit sound has been added.

5. Stage 6-4 Annabella waiting time and moving forward has been increased from 45 to 52 seconds.
->Anabella's boss rushes at the player alone and dies in an instant. Adjustments have been made to create a situation where the boss attacks the players in conjunction with monsters.

6. The character retreat button has been set to the shortcut Q.
-> There was a situation where it was very inconvenient to retreat the character only by clicking, so it has been changed so that the desired character can retreat when pressing the shortcut Q.

We are currently working hard to create the second half of the story! By the time it's complete, we'd like to reveal the update schedule, additional elements, and descriptions of new characters in advance. It's an insufficient work, but please give us a lot of interest.
Have a nice week!

notes.title: 2023-02-21 Update
notes.content:
Hello! While I was currently working on the second half of the story, there was a problem that needed to be fixed urgently, so I posted an update. We are very sorry to the players who are enjoying the game.

1. It was discovered that the game was not defeated properly when the giant bomb boss self-destructed in hard mode, and it has been fixed.

2. 6-4 Anabella's health and focused attack display size has been increased to make them more visible.

3. It was discovered and corrected that the contents were not displayed when Pandora reached level 50.

4. Some Pandora UI were not displayed properly, so it has been fixed.
:Critical hit  -> Critical hit chance

We apologize for any inconvenience you may have experienced while playing the game. For those of you who have strategies and questions about playing the game, Captain Bae is broadcasting on Twitch and when you search for Fantasya after 10:00 pm every day. Thank you for your interest!

notes.title: 2023-02-13 Update
notes.content:
Hello! This is Captain Mr.Bae. It's been a week and we're so thankful that so many of our players are playing our game more than they thought! These are the updates and bugs that will be applied this week.

1. The cooldown of the active skill used by the Stage 5 Megaphone Ghost is reduced from 10 seconds to 7 seconds.
-> In stage 5, the cycle of megaphone ghosts casting active skills on agents was long, so there was a situation where they cleared the stage quickly. Compared to the early stages, the difference in difficulty was not large, so we upgraded it to activate more active skills quickly.

2. Slightly increased the attack power of the 5th stage basic monster, The Ugly Ghost.
-> Ghosts appearing as basic ranged monsters in Stage 5 are difficult to reduce their physical strength even if many groups attack objects in the sub-stage, and considering the fact that they do not damage agents even if they attack the back row, the attack power of the distant ghosts has been slightly reduced. has been raised

3.4 Stage 4-4 Boss Monster gmdkdkdkdkdj's health has been raised.
-> It has been confirmed that the boss in the form of a story is much easier to catch than during the test. I raised the difficulty of the seeker by increasing the physical strength a little more because I could see a weak figure for a boss who is considered to be the strongest on the planet Fantasya.

4. Stage 6 6-4 boss monster Anabella's HP has been increased and gimmicks have been added.
-> It is a case where Annabella, the final boss of the first part of the story, was too difficult during the test and was lowered.
Anabella's HP has been slightly increased, and when activated, a poison that makes players suffer is released, so be careful.

5. The HP of the hard boss monster Giant Bomb Horse that appears in the simulation has been slightly increased.
-> It is relatively the easiest of the hard bosses, but it does not give the feeling of a hard mode at all, so its physical strength has been slightly increased. In addition, Megaphone Ghost's active skill cooldown has been reduced, making it more difficult, so please be careful.

In the future, we want to improve the completeness of the first part with continuous bugs and updates.
The development of the 2-part game is currently underway, and we want to finish early access as soon as possible and give players the pleasure of the game as a finished work. Have a good day!

4. Stage 6 6-4 boss monster Anabella's HP has been increased and gimmicks have been added.
5. The HP of the hard boss monster Giant Bomb Horse that appears in the simulation has been slightly increased.

notes.title: 2023-02-06 Update
notes.content:
At the same time as the first release, thanks to more players than expected, it is a great help in working! If you have any bugs or problems with the game while playing the game, I would appreciate it if you would actively send comments and e-mails!

1. In Pandora, an inconsistency in the output of the result window was found and corrected.

It has been corrected because there was a point where the production that originally occurred when going from 9 to 10 units per level occurred when going from 8 to 9.

2. Increased the scroll wheel speed for reading each character's profile in Unit Management.

It is a part that can be seen in detail by pulling the profile with the mouse point as well as the wheel of the mouse, but it is judged that the majority of people use the mouse wheel to scroll through, so the speed of turning the mouse wheel has been increased.

3. If you want to enjoy the game again after clearing all the contents of the 1st playthrough, if you initialize in the option window for the 2nd playthrough, the skip button for all dialogues will be activated.

In the second round, I added a skip button because it was judged that it was better to quickly move on to what I already knew. Please try to find hidden achievements by taking more various characteristics.

4. Fixed the issue where Annabella's motion freezes after using a specific skill in the hard mode boss.

5.Fixed the issue where the victory sign was not displayed when clearing hard mode.

6.Fixed hard mode Anabella's basic flat animation was not displayed.
